notes.title: Sex Hill - Progress of Myth of Angels universe newest entry
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]I'm eager to share some amazing progress what I have made on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656530/Sex_Hill/"]Sex Hill[/url] which plays in the same universe as my very first game. Let's jump right into the juicy details![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, the release date. I can confidently confirm that the game will be released in 2026! I know that it's just a half release date, but I still hope this is something what you can be excited for.[/p][p][/p][p]Secondly, a demo will be released before the launch. Yes you heard it right. You will have the chance to try the first part of the game completely free before the full release. More information about the demo will be shared prior its launch![/p][p][/p][p]Thirdly, hundreds of SFX are added to the game including moans and sex sounds. This feature was highly requested in my first game and I hear you all! Thanks to the SFX, the sex scenes are going to be even more steamier than before.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, here are some some previews and an amazing teaser trailer. Don't forget to watch the teaser trailer too after looking at these new preview images. notes.title: Wishlist Sex Hill - My brand new game!
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to finally show you what I've been working on for the past few months.

Even more mysteries, finer horror elements and of course a lot of lusty moments with jiggle & ripple effects!

But wait, the good news doesn't stop there! Sex Hill takes place in the Myth of Angels universe, so there are some secrets about some of the characters you already know!

Every wishlist counts, so kindly help me out!
Let's make this game to be my biggest release yet!

[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656530/Sex_Hill/?beta=0]Wishlist[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.title: PATCH 1.0.1 - Quality of life improvements
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update focuses mainly on the text side of the game. After all, we're reading a visual novel so the text should be in the best possible shape. Hopefully this update will make your reading experience even more enjoyable.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Many typos and grammar mistakes have been corrected throughout the game by a proofreader. We have tried our best to make your reading experience as smooth as possible.
[*] You can now skip the cleaning minigame if you have already completed it. (NOTE: If you completed the minigame in version 1.0.0, you will still need to complete it once).
[/list]

Bye-bye
3DeadAngel
